messages.text:
"Create an incremental game with Superpowers. The user gets to create a hero or villain and unlock different powers along their journey to make them stronger. They will also have stats they need to upgrade to become stronger, with no level cap. The game should be a 2d side scroller with different levels to fight through, each level shall contain an increasing amount of enemies who grow in power over time.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
